Incident history (1)

📅 2024-06-05 Armed Clashes / Fighting INC-151
escalation of fighting forced it to relocate to its second field hospital in Deir al Balah

On 5 June, the International Medical Corps (IMC) announced that the escalation of fighting had forced it to relocate all equipment and operations from its 160-bed field hospital in Rafah governorate to its second field hospital in Deir al Balah, thereby allowing it to continue to provide critical health services “while protecting the safety and security of its patients and staff.”
